prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Slugma (마그마그) personified, fire type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized clothing and accessory detail. Render the face and outfit at the same polished intensity.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her. Everyday clothing chosen for the scene; her species shows only as a small accessory, a motif on the clothing or a color echo — never armor, never a creature costume. Scene, outfit, pose and camera follow the settings below.

SCENE (chosen):
Expression: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes fixed on one point, mouth firmly closed
Pose: Capture the selected activity already in progress with a readable natural gesture.
Orientation: torso and pelvis face the camera; gaze is independent
Scene: In a ceramics studio at rainy noon, smoothing the rim of a small terracotta bowl on a stationary table, both hands separately visible above the table; diffuse window light and shelves of unmarked pottery.
Outfit and props: Opaque rust-red sleeveless ribbed scoop-neck top and high-waisted cream linen shorts; bare arms and midriff, a small amber pendant.
Category: Show a personal hobby or restful leisure moment with a specific action and relevant objects. Pokémon motifs may appear naturally in the activity, without requiring armor, a uniform or a companion.
Note: Same adult woman as the approved LIGHT reference. Preserve face structure, hair length and body. No armor or large species costume pieces; retain only the small jewelry motif. Exactly five separate digits per hand.
Framing: Waist-up framing showing the head, torso and relevant hand gesture; place essential props inside this crop.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
Camera: 1024x1536 portrait. All of both complete hands and their own forearms within the chosen framing.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

HANDS: each hand has one thumb and four fingers of natural length, clearly separated, never merged, doubled or extra.
